original_source_problem: 海邊露營情境先看到遠處燈塔的閃光，過一會才聽到海浪拍礁石的聲音，要求直接推論為何光比聲音快
scientific_defect: Observations originate from independent nonsimultaneous physical events: lighthouse flashing and waves hitting rocks. A later heard wave cannot by itself establish relative propagation speeds.
